subject: Assessment sprint charter & scoring alignment — Medibay trial
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medibay.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed assessment sprint charter (next steps)

Hi Olivia / Aaron —

Great to speak with you today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we spin up the trial: 

Summary of needs (from the call)
- Primary objective: validate that Redwood can reduce token cost and latency for Medibay’s note-generation microservice while preserving clinical accuracy in downstream triage tagging.
- Success metric (primary): end-to-end average latency < 450ms at 95th percentile for typical note lengths (150–400 tokens).
- Success metric (quality): top-1 clinical tag precision >= 92% against your adjudicated set; acceptable recall >= 88%.
- Volume target: baseline throughput of 20 req/s for initial shadow window, scaling to 100 req/s for stress acceptance.

Proposed assessment sprint (high level)
1) Week 0 — Onboarding: access + model selection, dataset access pattern, and security review (KMS, audit log config).
2) Week 1 — Offline evaluation: run our evaluation rubric on a representative, de-identified sample you provide (5k notes).
3) Week 2 — Shadow window (non-prod traffic): 3 days baseline + 2 days tuned configuration; compare production latencies and label agreement.
4) Week 3 — Acceptance workshop and handoff: grading review, acceptance sign-off, and next steps for production plan.

Owners (initial)
- Redwood AE / trial lead: Logan Wright (me) — commercial coordination & acceptance
- Redwood CSM: Karthik Iyer — trial ops, data ingestion, and success metrics tracking
- Redwood SE: Marissa Cole — model selection, runtime tuning, and instrumentation

Decision points we need from you by EOD Friday:
- Confirm the representative testset (5k de-identified notes) and a point-of-contact for data transfer.
- Confirm whether Medibay prefers offline-first evaluation or a shadow-first approach (we’ve outlined pros/cons below).

Offline-first vs. Shadow-first (quick note)
- Offline-first (recommended when labels exist): faster iteration on scoring/rubric; avoids exposing prod traffic; can pre-filter for edge cases.
- Shadow-first (recommended for behavioral validation): gives realistic latency and traffic patterns; catches upstream integration issues early.

I attached a one-page assessment charter and a preliminary evaluation rubric (draft). If you’re good with this plan I’ll schedule a kickoff for Monday and ping Karthik & Marissa to start the onboarding checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: medibay-assessment-charter-v1.xlsx, evaluation-rubric-draft.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed assessment sprint charter (internal coordination)

Thanks Logan — quick internal note on evaluation design and who should own which artifacts: 

Key tradeoffs I want to call out before we reply to Medibay:
- If they have gold labels for the 5k sample (preferred), do offline eval first. That will let us iterate on candidate prompts/temperature and run quantization profiles without touching prod.
- If labels are not ready, propose a 2-phase hybrid: run a 2-day shadow capture to produce a labeled seed, then full offline eval on the seed + sampling. This avoids long blind shadow runs.

Suggested owners & deliverables (internal)
- Soojin Lee (SE) — create the shadow capture plan and instrumentation checklist; ensure KV cache behavior is logged.
- Marissa Cole (SE) — build the evaluation harness and run the first-pass offline scores; produce the per-case grading spreadsheet.
- Karthik Iyer (CSM) — coordinate data transfer (S3 link / secure FTP) and maintain the success metrics dashboard (Sheet & a Metrics tab in the Drive folder).

I attached a draft rubric that converts model outputs into the 0/1/partial grades we'll use for the acceptance workshop. It's intentionally conservative on partial-credit rules. If Soojin or Karthik want to tweak thresholds I can update and re-share.

I propose we reply to Olivia with a clear preference: offline-first if they have labels; hybrid (short shadow -> offline) if they don't. Also ask for their intended trial start week so we can lock resource windows.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: evaluation-rubric-draft.pdf
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medibay.health>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medibay.health>
Date: 2027-10-04T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed assessment sprint charter (next steps)

Thanks Logan — this is helpful. A few quick answers from our side: 

- We can provide a 5k de-identified notes sample, but labels are partial (approximately 60% labeled). The labeled subset is high quality (the clinical annotation team did adjudication).
- Compliance ask: we need confirmation that audit logs for inference calls are retained for 90 days and that keys are customer-managed via our KMS. Please include a short note on this in the kickoff.
- Preference: hybrid approach — run a short 48-hour shadow capture (to validate integration and traffic patterns) then do the offline eval on the combined labeled set + seeded captures.
- Tentative timeline: aim to start onboarding next Monday (2027-10-11); can compress if Redwood can guarantee SE availability that week.

If that works, please send the data transfer instructions and a proposed kickoff agenda. Also loop in compliance if you need an SOC2 snippet prior to data transfer.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Director, Clinical Data Engineering
Medibay

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@medibay.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed assessment sprint charter (confirmed plan & kickoff)

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Olivia. Confirming the hybrid path (48h shadow -> offline eval on labeled + seeded captures). Below are the concrete next items and owners so we can hit your 2027-10-11 onboarding target: 

Immediate next steps (this week)
- Medibay: upload the 5k de-identified bundle to an S3 pre-signed URL (contact: aaron.patel@medibay.health). Ask compliance to confirm this transfer method is acceptable.
- Redwood (Karthik): I’ll set up the secure S3 endpoint and share instructions + retention policy.
- Redwood (Soojim Lee): build the shadow capture plan and instrument logs (capture window: 48 hours; sample rate: 10% of traffic or 1 req/s — whichever hits target volume sooner).
- Redwood (Marissa): finalize evaluation-rubric-v1.pdf into an executable grading sheet and map partial-credit rules to the adjudicated labels.

Kickoff agenda (30–40 min) — Monday 2027-10-11 (I’ll send calendar invite)
1) Introductions & objectives (5m)
2) Security & data transfer checklist (10m) — Karthik
3) Shadow capture design & instrumentation (10m) — Soojin
4) Offline eval rubric & acceptance gates (10m) — Marissa
5) Timeline & next milestones (5m)

Acceptance gates (proposed)
- Latency: 95th percentile under 450ms in the shadow window (config that will be considered for production).
- Quality: aggregated top-1 precision >= 92% across adjudicated labels; partial-credit cases reviewed in the workshop and weighted conservatively.
- Ops: audit logs present for all shadow requests and retained for 90 days; KMS key usage logged.

Attachments & links
- medibay-assessment-charter-v1.xlsx (charter and timeline)
- evaluation-rubric-draft.pdf (grading rules)
- Kickoff doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Medibay-Trial-Charter
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/medibay

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and the S3 instructions by EOD. Looking forward to kicking this off.

Thanks,
